role_review.scope: Necessary strokes on transparent host regions; explicit per-element map. No global recolor of filled artwork or geometry change.
role_review.contexts: Necessary strokes are evaluated on 17 named host contexts. Source-bound raw captures are retained in the separate acceptance archive.
role_review.old: #2A2A2A or fixed teal/coral on transparent paper/canvas
role_review.new: currentColor from the existing component text/icon role

internal_slashes.eye-off: currentColor on exposed host; #E05A5A clipped to original owned body
internal_slashes.bell-off: currentColor on exposed host; #E05A5A clipped to original owned body

role_review.classification_note: Historical role map is narrowed by necessary_identity_followup below: eyes, beaks, eye stalks, steam, connectors and off marks are necessary. Material seams/highlights need individual disposition; there is no blanket facial or steam exemption.

filled_role_review.source: Light-paper and dark-paper host contexts inspected at 1440x1000. Source-bound raw captures are retained in the separate acceptance archive.
filled_role_review.reason: Inherited host-facing pale stroke overpaints tiny dark internal marks on their own opaque light fill. Earlier transparent-host oracle does not cover these adjacencies. Preserve interior reference drawing ink explicitly, with unchanged geometry and fill bytes. Necessary interior identity marks receive own-backing raster assertions; decorative eyes/highlights/material seams are retained artwork, not a blanket contrast certificate.
filled_role_review.limits: Do not infer all163 artwork adjacencies or every component state accepted from this named oracle. Exterior art and necessary semantic identity are reviewed separately from static illustration detail.

roles.mouse: button separator and wheel boundary against own teal/coral backing
roles.trophy: achievement star against own yellow cup

necessary_role_followup.limits: 147 host-facing contours/closed silhouettes plus explicitly named semantic probes. Existing20 own-backing probes remain binding in icon_context_contrast_test.dart. This is not every multicolor adjacency or every browser state. Local clip/use is static owned-asset paint, never background inference or child inspection.

rules.R1: Root drawing ink #2A2A2A -> currentColor. It held for all 163 authored assets.
rules.carry: Authored per-attribute repairs are re-applied to upstream elements whose tag and geometry are unchanged, where upstream left the repaired attribute unchanged. A glyph-wide authored substitution (every element with an explicit paint value got the same new value) is re-applied to redrawn elements of that glyph with that value; those entries carry a reason and need owner confirmation.
rules.role_carry: Where upstream kept a glyph's element count and tag sequence, an element at the same position with unchanged paint attributes is the same role on moved geometry: its authored repairs are carried (reason 'role carry'), and when its measured role (stroke kind, host reach) is unchanged too, the previous review settles it (carried.<name>.roles_settled_by_role_carry) and no owner rule is applied to it.
rules.O1: colour-on-host: an explicit coloured stroke reaching the host background becomes currentColor (previous round: 28 of 32), unless its colour carries meaning (SEMANTIC_COLOUR).
rules.O2: fixed-ink-on-host: an explicit #2A2A2A stroke reaching the host becomes currentColor (previous round: 57 of 64).
rules.O3: inherited-interior: an inherited stroke lying only on the glyph's own paint becomes fixed drawing ink #2A2A2A (previous round: 148 of 167), only where #2A2A2A keeps 3:1 on every measured own backing; otherwise it stays currentColor and is held for the owner.
rules.O4: fixed-silhouette: a glyph whose contour reaches the host only in fixed paint has its host-reaching contour follow currentColor: O1/O2 on its strokes, and a host-reaching #2A2A2A fill (an ink outline drawn as a filled shape) becomes currentColor.
rules.O5: interior-contrast: interior detail under 3:1 on its own backing keeps the upstream paint as decorative interior detail (kept by rule, not certified as necessary).
rules.O6: semantic-colour: a SEMANTIC_COLOUR stroke, excluded from O1, keeps its hue and moves along OKLCH lightness (chroma and hue fixed, clipped to sRGB only if needed and recorded) to the first 8-bit colour that reaches 3:1 on light paper #F8F8F0, the least change that passes; it must keep 3:1 on dark paper and dark canvas or the import stops. No fixed colour reaches 3:1 on both the light canvas #88C9A1 and dark paper #243C33, so the light canvas stays under 3:1 (recorded per element with the ratios on the stroke's own backing, which O6 does not change).
rules.O7: owner-kept: the roles listed in OWNER_KEPT keep the upstream paint by owner decision; each keeps the measurement that stopped O1-O5, and no contrast matrix certifies it.
rules.semantic_colour: Excluded from O1 because the colour is the meaning, and settled by O6: cloud-off element 1 (red negation slash); location-off element 2 (red negation slash); mic-off element 3 (red negation slash); phone-off element 1 (red negation slash); video-off element 2 (red negation slash).
rules.repairs: Authored repairs on redrawn geometry (REPAIRS in the importer), measured per segment against the own paint under it; each listed under repairs.
rules.superseded: Where carried.<name>.repairs_dropped lists a repair, earlier sections of this file describe the previous asset of that glyph, not the current one.
rules.previous_round: Audit of the 163 authored assets against their pinned sources: 148 of 167 inherited interior strokes became fixed #2A2A2A, 57 of 64 explicit host-reaching #2A2A2A strokes became currentColor, 28 of 32 coloured host-reaching strokes became currentColor, plus individual recolours and clip splits. The owner adopted this majority practice as O1-O5 on 2026-11-17.
rules.measurement: Upstream geometry rasterised at 4 samples per unit; up to 2 samples of host exposure or own backing are edge noise. Held and O7 entries name the measured ratio that stops a rule; host ratios use light paper #F8F8F0, light canvas #88C9A1, dark paper #243C33, dark canvas #172B26.
